jobs.description:
CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.
You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

For a company based in Veurne, specialised in metalworking, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in various shift systems.

You will be working in an ultra-modern production environment that meets the highest standards in terms of quality, productivity and innovation. A very interesting opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities:

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will support customers with their maintenance activities.
• You will mainly be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs and the replacement of spare parts on industrial installations.
• You are able to work independently and are skilled in assembling and dismantling mechanical components.
• You will mainly work as part of the customer's technical maintenance team, always respecting the safety regulations applicable on site.
• You are responsible for accurately completing work orders and providing daily reports to the internal department.
• You work autonomously and maintain good communication with the customer.
• You have strong analytical skills to identify and troubleshoot technical faults and defects.
For this challenging position, you naturally need to have the right skills and experience.

• You have a strong ELECTRICAL & MECHANICAL BACKGROUND, with at least 5 years of experience as an industrial electrician.
• You are flexible regarding work locations, as you will work at different sites on a project basis.
• You are open to working in shifts (2-shift system, day shifts or night shifts – NEGOTIABLE).
• You are independent, eager to learn and not afraid of getting your hands dirty.
• You hold a valid category B driving licence and speak fluent DUTCH OR ENGLISH.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Copper Phase Out - Telecom
jobs.description:
The offer

• As a Project Manager you will join the Copper Phase-Out team and help accelerate the migration of customers from copper-based services to fibre.
• Customer migrations are yours to coordinate, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and customer continuity, action plans stay on track because you follow up on deadlines and dependencies.
• Together with the cross-functional teams, you validate migration paths and ensure their feasibility, internal stakeholders rely on you to support decision-making, resolve issues and keep departments aligned.
• Regular reports show the migration status and blockers, so progress remains visible.
• Compacting programmes also fall within your scope, as you support the consolidation of network sites or equipment.
• During rehosting activities, you ensure smooth transitions of services or equipment between platforms or locations.
• Equipment migration initiatives linked to modernisation, simplification or decommissioning plans benefit from your support.
• With the engineering and operational teams, you align actions related to network upgrades and resource optimisation.
• This role has a direct impact on the efficiency and evolution of the network infrastructure, and it lets you develop your operational, technical and coordination skills in a dynamic, multilingual environment.

Desired profile

• Full professional proficiency in French, Dutch and English, both spoken and written
• Good understanding of, or willingness to learn, telecom platforms, customer access technologies and provisioning flows
• The following are an asset:
• experience in telecom operations, service provisioning or network migration
• previous involvement in cross-functional or transformation projects
💡 Your skills

• Complex technical cases don't put you off: you analyse them and propose migration solutions.
• New internal tools and systems for migration and network transformation are quickly mastered.
• Strong communication and coordination skills help you collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
• Your organisational skills allow you to manage diverse topics simultaneously.
🌟 Who are you?

• A problem solver with a proactive attitude, who takes ownership of actions
• Customer-oriented, structured and reliable

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

jobs.occupation: Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Beerse
jobs.description:
As a Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer, you are responsible for preparing, maintaining and executing qualification documentation for GMP-critical equipment, utilities and systems. You ensure that all documentation complies with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality standards. You work closely with C&Q Leads, Subject Matter Experts and project teams to support qualification projects from initiation through completion. Besides document preparation, you also participate in qualification testing and follow-up activities. Your work plays an important role in ensuring that systems remain in a validated and compliant state.
Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Writing qualification documentation including URS, SRS, IA, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, QSR and Validation Master Plans
 
• Executing and documenting qualification tests for equipment, utilities and systems
 
• Assessing the impact of changes, deviations and discrepancies on qualification activities
 
• Coordinating document reviews, approval flows and signature processes
 
• Following up punch list items and qualification actions until closure
 
• Supporting internal and external audits and inspections
 
• Managing document archiving in accordance with GMP and GDP requirements

You are structured, quality-minded and eager to learn. You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and enjoy working in a team-oriented GMP environment. At the same time, you are capable of independently managing documentation and qualification activities.

What you bring

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or technical field such as Industrial Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
 
• Strong interest in the pharmaceutical industry and GMP-regulated environments
 
• Excellent technical writing and documentation skills
 
• Experience with engineering systems, utilities or manufacturing equipment is an asset
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities

• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

These activities include post-trade processing, cash and payment services, portfolio transfers, tax services, income and corporate actions, and account administration.

 
As an Operations – Cash & Payments Junior Associate, you will:

• Contribute to the development and implementation of new processes and systems, as well as the continuous improvement of existing ones, with the aim of increasing efficiency, complying with new regulations and market standards, and reducing operational risk. 
 
• Proactively follow and integrate operational and procedural changes to keep your knowledge and expertise up to date. 
 
• Participate in knowledge sharing and training, both receiving training from colleagues and sharing your own expertise across the department. 

 
• A Master's degree or equivalent experience, preferably within the financial sector. 
 
• French or Dutch as your main language, combined with a very good command of the other national language and English. 
 
• A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to learn and share knowledge. 
 
• A dynamic, proactive and confident personality. 
 
• A strong client-focused mindset and good communication skills. 
 
• Strong analytical skills, combined with the ability to synthesize complex information. 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong general digital skills.
